hero.label: Made for Storylane
hero.headline: I want to help Storylane turn demos into pipeline.
hero.subheadline: Interactive demos are collapsing the gap between interest and conviction for SaaS buyers, and Storylane is at the center of that shift. I spent over a year doing cold outreach as a BDR and then moved into B2B digital marketing at NextAfter, so I understand both sides of the funnel Storylane serves. I want to bring that dual perspective to an SDR role where the product itself makes every conversation easier to start.

whyCompany.title: Storylane makes the demo the first real sales moment
whyCompany.body: Most SaaS buyers bounce before they ever talk to a rep because they can not visualize the product fast enough. Storylane flips that by letting prospects experience value before a discovery call even happens. That changes what an SDR conversation looks like, and I find that genuinely exciting.

whyCompany.title: Early-stage SDR roles shape how the whole motion gets built
whyCompany.body: Joining a startup at this stage means the outreach playbook is still being written, not handed down. The sequences, the ICP refinement, the messaging tests, those decisions actually matter and stick. That is the environment where I learn fastest and contribute most.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and digital marketing background maps directly here
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach through HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch. Then at NextAfter I learned how B2B buyers actually respond to digital touchpoints from the marketing side. Selling a demo tool to marketing and sales teams is exactly the intersection those two experiences prepared me for.

quote: I have sat on the other side of a bad product demo and watched a deal go cold. The fact that Storylane exists to fix that problem is reason enough for me to want to be the person opening those doors.
